commercial_frame.claim_boundary: Target value is sponsor-perceived strategic value from reusable assets, risk reduction, and decision acceleration; it is not a guaranteed savings claim.

go_live_required_gates.acceptance: make m42-sandbox-validate passes with zero failures, including validator RPC, TEE /execute smoke, zkML /prove smoke, archive, Prometheus, and Alertmanager.
Workload and model manifests forbid live patient data and PHI; any non-synthetic data requires written scope change.

Every accepted job has TEE attestation, zkML proof object, matching model/circuit hashes, chain_id, seal_id, validator_signature, archive_pointer, verification flags, and fallback mode accepts zero jobs.
The fixture model digest is replaced by the approved Med42-compatible checkpoint or hosted endpoint digest before customer-approved data is introduced.
The active circuit hash and verifying key hash are registered and included in every accepted evidence bundle.
Missing TEE, missing zkML, wrong model hash, PHI injection, fallback mode, and stale nonce replay are mutated from a real bundle, hashed, executed through the policy harness, and rejected.
Evidence archive, Prometheus, and Alertmanager are reachable and retained for the pilot period.
M42 sponsor accepts the value-bank structure, mutual action plan, and Week 4 executive value board outputs.
m42-pilot-gap-register.json is generated and all FAIL findings are closed or explicitly dispositioned before live claims.
Go types, JSON schema, OpenAPI, TypeScript SDK, sponsor docs, and generated bundles all require the canonical enterprise evidence bundle fields.

warning_gates.acceptance: Loopback/private archive is acceptable for rehearsal; hosted customer access requires authentication, TLS, or private connectivity.
All pretestnet drill fixtures are replaced by live sandbox outputs before final M42 claims.
